items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I’m very close to Ron Carter

ctx.x: So I’m starting to look at things in a way that, when I talk to my son I seem old. You see what I mean? So each generation says I don’t know how you guys are going to make it. It wasn’t like that in my day. And they find a way to make it. So I think a lot of times, no disrespect to any generation, but I think we fabricate things in a way to make it seem like it was so much better when we grew up, when it was just that way when we grew up. It doesn’t make it better, it was the way it was. So I was fortunate to…
